sources.entry: Kept Notes - A notes app built for quick capture: text notes, checklists, images, drawings, links, attachments, labels, colors, and reminders (alternative to Google Keep). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0/MIT Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Kept is a Google Keep-style notes app for quick capture (text, checklists, images, drawings, links, attachments, reminders) that runs device-only on iOS/Android or as a self-hosted server via Docker.
use_cases: Quick capture of text notes, checklists and photos on a phone
Self-hosting a Google Keep-style notes app on a home or private server
Sharing and collaborating on notes with other users on the same instance
Keeping notes offline on a device with no account or server
Setting time or location reminders for notes
Importing Google Keep Takeout data into a self-hosted notes app
how_to_run: Open the Kept web address in a browser and create the first admin account.
To update: docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
notable: Device-only mode in native iOS and Android apps with no server or account required
Real-time collaborative sharing of notes between users on the same instance
Local and remote MCP server options and OAuth 2.1 access for scoped integrations
Optional OpenID Connect single sign-on alongside local accounts
Full server backup and restore flow including images and attachments
caveats: Sharing, web access, and cross-device sync require a Kept server (self-hosted or Kept Cloud, a paid hosted option).
Location-based reminders and some mobile features require the native iOS or Android apps.
Real-time WebSocket updates need reverse-proxy WebSocket support; custom gateway headers do not apply to WebSocket connections.
